islands.rule: whole position-connected islands lying inside the box min [-0.02,-0.13,-0.13] max [0.02,0.02,-0.08] (m)

pivot.rule: the top centre of the part (x / z centre, max y): the magazine well

Grip.rule: x = the middle of a ray along X at y / z (the outermost surfaces: the local mid-plane)

Muzzle.rule: the front face: z = the minimum z; x / y = the centre of the vertices within 0.004 m of it

Sight.rule: x = the middle of a ray along X at y / z (the outermost surfaces: the local mid-plane)

Eject.rule: x = the right-hand receiver surface (the right-most hit of a ray along X at y / z [0.065,-0.05], beside the port)

processing.markerNotes: Sight: the eye line through the rear flip aperture (open 0.098 - 0.120) at the front post tip (0.1075); Eject: the port window on the right of the upper receiver; Grip: the pistol grip at mid-hand height
